public_label: Indicative packages — final scope confirmed together

packages.name: Positioning Sprint
packages.descriptor: A focused foundation before an ongoing program.
deliverables: One founder/buyer-positioning workshop
LinkedIn headline, About and featured-section plan
Buyer-language and search-term map
Four editorial themes and a 30-day direction
Founder/company message alignment brief
not_included: Automated outreach or live account actions
packages.interviews: One structured 60-minute source conversation plus a review session.
packages.scope_note: One founder profile. Project timing and revisions confirmed in the brief.

packages.name: Founder Presence
packages.descriptor: A consistent editorial presence around one founder.
deliverables: Eight original LinkedIn pieces/month, including up to two carousel or visual pieces
Two regular 45-minute founder interviews/month
Profile and publication language aligned to buyer search intent
Source notes, technical/voice review and agreed approval workflow
Monthly content and qualified-response review
not_included: A guaranteed ranking, lead or revenue outcome
packages.interviews: Two 45-minute source interviews/month; asynchronous factual review.
packages.scope_note: One founder. Format mix, approval timing and tooling confirmed before work starts.

packages.name: Founder + Company
packages.descriptor: Connect the founder’s voice to the company story.
deliverables: Twelve founder LinkedIn pieces/month, including up to four visual/document pieces
Four company adaptations/month, each with a separate purpose
Weekly 30-minute founder/source interviews
Monthly outreach and customer-conversation copy review
Campaign creative direction and a monthly learning review
Up to two short video edits from permissioned supplied footage instead of two written pieces
not_included: Ad spend and paid media buying unless separately scoped
Inbox takeover, bulk messaging or connection automation
New filming, voice cloning or unlicensed footage
A promise of meetings, reach or revenue
packages.interviews: Weekly 30-minute source conversations; technical expert input when required.
packages.scope_note: One founder plus one company voice. Final capacity, cadence, terms and permissions require agreement.

tax_and_cost_note: Proposed service fees. Applicable taxes, platform subscriptions and media spend are additional where required. Commercial terms remain to be agreed.

basis.method: Original EUR offer architecture informed by the field’s modular service mix and displayed order-of-magnitude fees. These rates are a commercial proposal,not an exchange-rate conversion or computed competitor average.
limitations: No owner acceptance of final rates inferred

search.title: LinkedIn search,profile and publication optimization
search.copy: Use the language your intended buyers recognize. Align the profile, company description and publication themes with the problems and terms that matter to them, then review available Search Appearances and response data.
deliverables: Buyer-language/search-term hypothesis map
Natural profile headline/About/experience/skills alignment where relevant
Publication theme, title and on-screen wording clarity
Authorized Search Appearances baseline and review
search.boundary: No search position, keyword volume, ranking or algorithm boost is guaranteed. LinkedIn search observation is not website SEO or paid-ad targeting.

outreach.title: Outreach and customer conversations
outreach.copy: Make the next conversation relevant. Develop considerate conversation starters, follow-up copy and response guidance around an approved buyer and a genuine reason to speak.
deliverables: Buyer-fit and reason-to-contact brief
Manual outreach and follow-up copy
Customer-question and response library
Review of authorized conversation themes
outreach.boundary: No scraping, bulk sending, inbox takeover or account action is implied. Any real contact requires approved scope, account authority and platform-compliant methods.

interviews.title: Regular interviews,not a one-time download
interviews.copy: Keep the content connected to the work. Regular founder and expert conversations capture new decisions, questions, evidence and stories as the business changes.
interviews.boundary: Cadence and participation are agreed for each engagement. Confidential information and third-party stories require permission.
